summary: Electronic Arts' post-FIFA football simulation franchise, continuing EA Sports' annual club football series across console, PC, cloud, Switch, and mobile platforms.

entries.title: EA Sports FC 24
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version / Ultimate Edition where owned

emulation.notes: Run the PC version natively with current title updates.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows current-generation build at highest stable settings

primary.version: PC version / Ultimate Edition where owned
primary.why: EA Sports FC 24 launched on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S in 2023. Windows, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S receive the current-generation feature set including HyperMotion V, while Switch lacks those features and cross-platform play; Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with the latest title updates; use PS5/Xbox Series X/S as equivalent current-generation console routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service/annual sports title; Ultimate Team, licensing, and online features change over time. Switch is no longer a simple legacy edition but still lacks some current-generation features.

entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version / Ultimate Edition where owned

emulation.notes: Run the PC version natively with current title updates.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.version: PC version / Ultimate Edition where owned
primary.why: EA Sports FC 25 released worldwide in 2024 for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the second EA Sports FC mainline entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with the latest title updates; use PS5/Xbox Series X/S as equivalent current-generation console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service/annual sports title; online modes, Ultimate Team economy, and licenses change over time.

entries.title: EA Sports FC 26
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version / Ultimate Edition where owned

emulation.notes: Run the PC version natively with current title updates.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.version: PC version / Ultimate Edition where owned
primary.why: EA Sports FC 26 released worldwide in September 2025 for Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and Amazon Luna. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route, with Switch 2 a notable portable current-generation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with the latest title updates; use PS5/Xbox Series X/S or Switch 2 as strong platform alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service/annual sports title; FC Showcase is a free preview, not a separate full release. Online modes, licenses, and Ultimate Team content change over time.

entries.title: EA Sports FC Mobile
entries.definitive_edition: Current Android/iOS mobile build; Android as primary access route

emulation.notes: Use active mobile app distribution where available; general emulation is secondary to real mobile hardware.

primary.why: EA Sports FC Mobile succeeded FIFA Mobile in 2023 on iOS and Android as the mobile branch of the EA Sports FC franchise. Android is the most flexible mobile access/preservation route, while iOS is equivalent for normal play where available.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Android build through the active mobile distribution path; use iOS as an equivalent route if already installed/available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile live-service entry; seasons, rosters, modes, and market systems change over time.
